ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels and 30% high-intensity (white/light grey) linear and circular features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central field is predominantly low-intensity black. Left lobe displays vertical high-intensity white striations along the lateral margin. Right lobe features localized high-intensity circular rings and semi-circles distributed across the medial and distal regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate 45-degree interior angle between lobe origins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge displays moderate-frequency serrations. Right lobe trailing edge is highly irregular with a significant macro-scale jagged recession (missing tissue segment) and high-amplitude sharp peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a standard convex upward sweep. Right lobe exhibits a disrupted, irregular trajectory due to substantial structural trailing-edge loss.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular and ovoid rings (depigmentation marks) concentrated on the right lobe, including three prominent 'O' shaped markers in the upper distal quadrant.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, unaligned high-intensity white linear streaks (rake marks) cutting across the black pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural amputation/trauma on the trailing edge of the right lobe resulting in a large jagged gap. Extensive scarring from possible Orca interaction (rake marks) and parasitic attachment points (circular scars).
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy concentrations of tan-colored, high-relief pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
